title: NativeShapeContract
description: The detected, immutable shape of one customer input as it entered Baltor. Baltor wraps the customer's existing format — it never forces a new one — so the shape (format, field order, encoding, delimiter, newline, mime type) is captured EXACTLY once at ingest and is the contract every same-shape projection must honor. schema_hash + the exact source bytes' content_hash make a projection reproducible/auditable; the original is NEVER overwritten. Lossless distillation: this record is a source handle, not a transform of the source.
